title: Ahu
author: Büşra Yörük
description: Ahu’s life is turned upside down when her father dies in a car accident during her final year of high school, leaving her responsible for her paralyzed mother and struggling to keep them afloat. When her new literature teacher offers guidance toward a brighter future, she resists at first, but her anger slowly softens into love. Meanwhile, Alparslan, who has long loved her, promises security and an escape from poverty, forcing Ahu to choose between her heart and her duty. As she faces heartbreak and hope, she learns that survival means balancing love with responsibility and embracing life’s unexpected turns.
